answer: A lantern-like beacon grid assigns each agent a licensed spatial slot whose received signal strength must match its claimed position within a tight link budget. Any haven of cloned identities collapses because colliding slots raise interference above the noise floor, forcing attackers to buy scarce spectrum and physically distribute radios. This prism of coverage, capacity and interference limits sybils to real estate and license costs, though relay spoofing near cell edges remains the residual leak.
